verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a public API reference for managing databases programmatically [docs-49]. It also documents service tokens for headless and CI authentication [docs-7, docs-44], and Terraform support, which is built on that API [docs-38]. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the standard paths), detailed endpoint and auth coverage in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
